release_notes:
Fix custom fields disappearing on some server-based services

A handful of "credits for existing account" style services could lose
their username field entirely after a supplier refreshed their
catalog -- leaving the order form with nothing to fill in, so orders
had no way to say which account to credit. This happened specifically
when a supplier's field requirements hadn't been re-fetched yet (for
example right after they moved to a new platform), which the sync
was treating the same as "this service needs no extra information"
and clearing the field as a result. It no longer does that -- an
existing field is now left alone until the supplier's current
requirements are actually known again.

Eighteen affected services have had their field restored, and one
affected order has been identified for manual follow-up.
